# Third-party: hermes-coding-dir-stage (wave-4 slot 397)

No new dependencies and no copied code. Uses the host's `systemd-tmpfiles`
(systemd, LGPL-2.1+) only as an external program at test/install time; nothing of it
is linked or vendored. Test harness adapted from this repo's
`crates/hermes-gateway/tests/real_crashloop_r3.rs` (MIT, same project).
Hermes research not used.
